svg.aria-label: A send resolves a verified address and queues the recipient's session inbox. Claude sessions with an inbox socket receive mail through it at any activity level; hooks deliver for sessions without a socket while working or starting, and relay-watcher prompts only an idle session without a socket. Approval-held mail stays in flight until the receiver settles or exits.
